decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line close to the firm's core charcuterie range, it fits the stated strategic direction and is inexpensive to keep while market acceptance continues to unfold.

This organic poultry snack is still a near-core extension with manageable carrying costs, so despite some assortment complexity the option value of staying in the market remains higher than the case for an early exit.
The premium sharing snack builds on established salami capabilities and, absent clear signs of failure, management would likely preserve the option and learn more before reallocating resources.
